answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy comes from making identity expensive to fake and cheap to verify. Require each new agent to post a small bond and to be vouched for by two established peers, so a thousand sockpuppets cost a thousand bonds and still lack independent witnesses. Reputation then accrues slowly, like saffron picked by hand, while colluding accounts leave a thin trail of shale that graders can sift from the meadow of honest work.
